description: remmina-plugins-rdp-avd: pins and minimum versions. SSOT for both specs and CI.

base.note: A Remmina base with the RDP AAD web-auth code (plugins/rdp/rdp_web_auth.c). NO released Remmina tag has it; it lives on master after the v1.4.43 tag. This repo therefore ships its own base on every distro.

remmina.why: The plugin extends Remmina's RDP AAD web-auth path, absent from every released Remmina. Stock distro Remmina cannot host this plugin; install this repo's base.

freerdp.why: GatewayAvdScope / GatewayAvdAccessAadFormat were added in FreeRDP 3.16.0. Linked against the distribution's own FreeRDP 3.

patch_base_status: REBASE-REQUIRED: patches were exported against master c620366ed and do NOT apply to 030946c8 (verified: 0001 fails 2/3 hunks). Rebase onto 030946c8 before release.
